name: Wizard OS 0.2.0
about: One Wizard OS version: the commit of every component repo, the images those commits produced, and the default app in each parking spot. Check with: python3 tools/check_release.py releases/0.2.0.json

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

wizard-app-manager.note: Alongside mode is wizard-app-manager PR #12, now on top of main (Miguel's #13 merged: fresh boxes + arm64). Second revision answers Miguel's review: a re-run keeps the box's mode, and the shell gets no Hermes home by default. This pin moves to main when #12 merges.

wizard-os.note: specs + the generic `wizard` CLI: link makes three edits (#19 dropped the eager_tools edit stock Hermes ignores), doctor reports the shell's history mode (#20). Byte-identical copy vendored at wizard-app-manager/wizard-cli/ (SOURCE.json pins it). A release file cannot name the commit that adds it, so this pins the commit before it.

wizard-app-manager.note: multi-arch since wizard-app-manager #13 (arm64 built from x86)
